name: git fetch
purpose: Download new commits and branch info from a remote without merging them into your working files.
explanation: Unlike `git pull` (which fetches AND merges), `git fetch` safely downloads remote updates so you can inspect them before merging.
explanationOfOutput: Updates remote-tracking branch `origin/main` without touching your local `main` working tree.
whenToUse: When you want to check for remote updates without immediately altering local files.
commonMistakes: Expecting `git fetch` to update files in your working directory (use `git pull` or `git merge` after).
commonErrors: fatal: 'origin' does not appear to be a git repository
